UNIKERNEL_POD_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install unikernel_pod. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

UNIKERNEL_POD_VERSION.description: Specific version of unikernel_pod to install.

UNIKERNEL_POD_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading unikernel_pod binary or archive artifacts.

UNIKERNEL_POD_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying unikernel_pod available remote releases.

UNIKERNEL_POD_VMM.description: Target virtual machine monitor for multi-unikernel pod synthesis (qemu, firecracker, cloud-hypervisor, bhyve, solo5-hvt).

UNIKERNEL_POD_SUBNET.description: IPv4 /24 prefix assigned deterministically across decomposed unikernel pod appliances.

UNIKERNEL_POD_OUT_DIR.description: Output directory where decomposed unikernel appliance images and launch scripts are written.
